english.title: Fail to disclose registered name in communications
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were

(A)_[a company which,]_
(B)_[an officer of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..), who was in default, the company having,]_

without reasonable excuse, failed to disclose its registered name on

(C)_[its business letters]_
(D)_[its business notices]_
(E)_[its official publications]_
(F)_[its bills of exchange]_
(G)_[its promissory notes]_
(H)_[its endorsements]_
(I)_[its order forms]_
(J)_[cheques purporting to be signed by or on behalf of the company]_
(K)_[orders for money, goods or services, namely **(..SPECIFY ORDER..), purporting to be signed by or on behalf of the company]_
(L)_[its bills of parcels, invoices and other demands for payment]_
(M)_[its receipts or letters of credit]_
(N)_[its applications for licences to carry on a trade or activity]_
(O)_[forms of its business correspondence]_
(P)_[its website or websites]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 24 and 28 of the Company, Limited Liability Partnership and Business (Names and Trading Disclosures) Regulations 2015.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: A shadow director is to be treated as an officer of the company - see section 28(3).
